WITH synthetic_sales_data AS (
  -- Create representative sales revenue data by category and region
  SELECT 'North' as region, 'Electronics' as category, 125000.00 as total_revenue UNION ALL
  SELECT 'North', 'Clothing', 85000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'North', 'Home & Garden', 62000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'North', 'Sports', 48000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'North', 'Books', 35000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'South', 'Electronics', 98000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'South', 'Clothing', 112000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'South', 'Home & Garden', 71000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'South', 'Sports', 54000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'South', 'Books', 28000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'East', 'Electronics', 145000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'East', 'Clothing', 93000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'East', 'Home & Garden', 77000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'East', 'Sports', 61000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'East', 'Books', 42000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'West', 'Electronics', 118000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'West', 'Clothing', 105000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'West', 'Home & Garden', 88000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'West', 'Sports', 69000.00 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'West', 'Books', 38000.00
),
ranked_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    category,
    total_revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) as rank,
    SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as region_total_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * total_revenue / SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 2) as revenue_pct
  FROM synthetic_sales_data
)
SELECT 
  region,
  category,
  total_revenue,
  rank,
  region_total_revenue,
  revenue_pct,
  CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN 'TOP' ELSE '' END as is_top_category
FROM ranked_categories
ORDER BY region, rank
